'''Nalrith''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE" /> located in the [[Nalrith system/Legends|Nalrith system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Nalrithian]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The homeworld of the Nalrithian species was indirectly mentioned in the [[2008]] ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Nalrith [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square N-20.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', has [[:File:JasonFryAtlas.png|stated]] that the star systems listed in the book's Appendix section are named after the most prominent planets or celestial bodies located in those systems. This article therefore considers the Nalrithian homeworld to be named in accordance with the Nalrith system.<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=[[Nalrithian]]|system=[[Nalrith system/Legends|Nalrith system]]|legends=1}}</ref>
